lines.en: label mayanightgen:
scene mayanightcallgen
I give Maya a call and ask her to come over to my secret apartment so the two of us can not have sex with each other.
lines.zh: 我给 Maya 打电话，叫她来我的秘密公寓，好让我俩不跟对方上床。

lines.en: Boring, I know. But given that she actually cares about me and doesn't want my brain to melt, this is really all we can do.
lines.zh: 无聊，我知道。但既然她是真的在乎我、不想让我的脑子化掉，我们也只能做到这一步。

lines.en: Am I willing to risk that for what I have come to personally refer to as “The forbidden vagina?” Probably. But alas, I remain unwillingly abstinent in the face of greater peril.
lines.zh: 我愿意为了那个我私下称之为「禁忌之穴」的东西冒那个险吗？大概愿意。但可惜，面对更大的危险，我依然不情不愿地保持着禁欲。

lines.en: Incessant innuendo aside, this is fine. It's good that we can be together now without the constant bickering and references to how disgusting I am.
lines.zh: 没完没了的黄腔放一边，这样也挺好。我们现在能待在一起，不再不停地拌嘴、不再反复提我有多恶心，这很好。

lines.en: Which isn't to say we are together without those things. They still happen.
lines.zh: 不是说我们在一起时没有那些东西。它们还是有。

lines.en: But they don't have to.
And they only do because that's what “normal” is for us.
lines.zh: 而它们之所以还有，只是因为那对我俩来说就是「正常」。

lines.en: scene black
We spend the night out on the balcony, looking up at the stars and the moon.
lines.zh: 我们在阳台上过了一夜，抬头看星星和月亮。

lines.en: And every time I try to touch her, my hand is slapped away.
lines.zh: 而每次我想碰她，我的手就被拍开。

lines.en: It stings, but not due to the sensation.
lines.zh: 很刺痛，但不是因为那触感。

lines.en: It stings because she's the one thing I want that I'm not allowed to have.
lines.zh: 痛是因为她是我唯一想要、却不被允许拥有的东西。

Maya's affection has increased to [maya_love]!
lines.zh: Maya 的好感度提升到了 [maya_love]！
